name: Trigger Editor
description: GUI triggers (war3map.wtg) and custom script (war3map.wct): the tree of categories, triggers and variables, names, flags, comments, undo and saving. What a trigger contains is shown by trigger kinds from other extensions (service w3.triggers).

mcpTools.name: add_trigger_variable
mcpTools.description: Adds a global variable; scripts call it udg_<name>. A plain JASS trigger can't declare globals itself, so this is how scripts keep state. Needs the setting mcp.writeTools; undo_last_edit takes it back.

type.description: A trigger type, like integer, real, unit, group, timer, hashtable.

mcpTools.name: remove_trigger_variable
mcpTools.description: Removes a global variable, by its name with or without udg_. Refused while a trigger or the custom script uses it, and the answer says which. Needs the setting mcp.writeTools; undo_last_edit takes it back.

mcpTools.name: set_script_header
mcpTools.description: Replaces the map's custom script: code placed before all triggers, for functions several triggers share. Needs the setting mcp.writeTools; undo_last_edit takes it back.

mcpTools.name: remove_trigger
mcpTools.description: Removes a trigger and its script. Needs the setting mcp.writeTools; undo_last_edit takes it back.

mcpTools.name: set_trigger_enabled
mcpTools.description: Turns a trigger on or off in the map. Needs the setting mcp.writeTools; undo_last_edit takes it back.

mcpTools.name: set_trigger_script
mcpTools.description: Replaces the script of a trigger written in script (see list_triggers). Needs the setting mcp.writeTools; undo_last_edit takes it back.

script.description: The whole new text, in the language of the map (see map_info).

mcpTools.name: create_script_trigger
mcpTools.description: Adds a trigger written in script. To run at map start the text must define InitTrig_<name> takes nothing returns nothing, with spaces in the name as _; without it the text is only a library. It usually sets gg_trg_<name> and registers events. Check it with build_script. Needs the setting mcp.writeTools; undo_last_edit takes it back.

category.description: Category to put it in (default: the first).

mcpTools.name: list_triggers
mcpTools.description: The open map's triggers by category, each marked gui or script, and optionally its variables.

mcpTools.name: get_trigger
mcpTools.description: One trigger in full: its events, conditions and actions as the World Editor words them, or its script.

commands.title: Trigger Editor: Toggle Trigger Initially On
Trigger Editor: Rename or Delete a Trigger or Variable

services.description: Trigger kinds (GUI, custom script, …) shown in the trigger editor: registerKind; the open editor's triggers (unsaved changes included): liveTriggers, onDidEdit; objects renamed elsewhere in its GUI parameters at once, undone with the rename: followRenames.
